requirements.requirement: The product/module is JSONHTML in the same package; its target depends on JSON and the exact public set contains five products.

Data/String/report APIs, checked Sendable configuration, finite presets and asset strategy compile through a public consumer.
All six root kinds, empty containers and mixed deep/wide structures produce a complete strict UTF-8 HTML document.
Large integers, exact decimals, negative zero and admitted exponent/number spellings survive display and exported JSON without JS numeric conversion.
Scalar-distinct composed/decomposed keys/strings and insertion/array order remain distinct and ordered.
One noncopyable invocation meter covers admission, traversal, token helpers, paths, assets, Base64, annotations and result copies.
Inclusive boundaries and checked overflow cover core work/output/retention and renderer node/DOM/document/outline/annotation capacities.
Cancellation inside owned loops and valid restrictive/zero ceilings produce honest failures without a successful partial result/report.
Repeated and concurrent calls have exclusive state; deterministic output uses stable IDs/assets and no clock/random mutation.
Data and String materialization charges are complete; final-document byte count is distinguished from cumulative core helper output.
Formatted mode has no script; interactive native disclosure remains usable with scripting disabled and allows multiple open branches.
Default expansion, bounded outline, ancestor opening, focus, root/empty/numeric/special-key paths and generated IDs behave coherently.
Copy/download bytes decode to the owned formatted JSON; RFC Pointer metadata preserves controls, CR/LF, NUL and exact scalar sequences.
Raw and escaped Pointer copy modes have explicit labels; unavailable clipboard behavior is reported and manual/UTF-8 alternatives work.
Literal search is bounded/chunked, preserves scalar distinction, opens matched ancestors and reports its rendered-text scope honestly.
Script/style closing strings, ampersands, quotes, event-handler payloads and keys such as __proto__/constructor remain inert data.
No payload-driven innerHTML, executable interpolation, URLs/selectors or script-element text assignment appears in the output/control path.
Emitted CSS/JS asset hashes match CSP block bytes; controls work under policy and external resource requests remain absent.
Annotations attach by exact typed path or identify missing targets at their parent; no empty list asserts schema validity.
JSONDocument locations remain coherent, unmapped/replaced roots invent none, and annotation messages/paths are bounded and escaped.
Safari, Firefox and Chromium execute file/served, JS on/off, outline/search/copy/download and policy cases with recorded versions.
Keyboard/focus, text/contrast/themes and relevant VoiceOver behavior are reviewed; accessibility claims match the executed evidence.
Print output includes every value regardless of collapse/script state, excludes UI clutter, and preserves applicable UI state.
Five-product/platform/resource qualification; pure rendering does not execute UI frameworks, while JSONHTML may link narrowly isolated Apple PDF/printing frameworks.
